note: Set A binds the material and member sizes more faithfully: plywood/reclaimed wood surface 3/4" x 5 1/2", 2" x 8" joist and frame, 3/8" x 4" hex through bolt (including head type), 3/4" threaded rod, and the FIRST FLR 2'-4" / GRADE LEVEL 0" elevations all match the B1/B4/C3 callouts. Set B makes clear misbindings and inventions: it assigns 3/4" x 5 1/2" to the joist (with a garbled quote), labels the 4X4 post as a footing member type, invents an 'offset from edge to post 1' attribute, merges '1" NUT' and 'SLEVE' into one 'nut sleeve' dimension, and files several A6/C1 dimensions under 'C1 DECKING' or the landscape footing. Both sets have vague 'component 1' claims and misfile some A6 detail dimensions (1 1/4", 3 3/4", 8'-0", 1'-0"), but A's errors are fewer and less severe, and A captures the through-bolt head type and plywood thickness that B misses.
